verdict.rationale: Period locking is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. The evidence covers AI Close month-end automation, reconciliation, and automatic reversing entries when a manual journal entry is edited, but it never documents locking a closed period or requiring an explicit reopening. Reversing entries are an adjacent audit-trail behavior, not a period lock.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
